protected_invariants.heading: Tool Boundaries
protected_invariants.text: This skill is **100% read-only** during triage. It MUST NEVER send, reply, forward, delete, archive, or modify any message during triage.

protected_invariants.heading: Tool Boundaries
protected_invariants.text: - `gws gmail +reply --id <ID>` — reply to email (**only during `/act` with user approval**)

protected_invariants.heading: Tool Boundaries
protected_invariants.text: - `gws gmail +forward --id <ID>` — forward email (**only during `/act` with user approval**)

protected_invariants.heading: Tool Boundaries
protected_invariants.text: - `gws chat +send` — send chat message (**only during `/act` with user approval**)

protected_invariants.heading: Tool Boundaries
protected_invariants.text: - `gws gmail users messages modify` — archive email (**only during `/archive` or `/sweep`, with user approval**)

protected_invariants.heading: Tool Boundaries
protected_invariants.text: - `gws gmail users messages trash` — delete email (**only during `/delete` or `/sweep`, with user approval**)

protected_invariants.heading: Tool Boundaries
protected_invariants.text: Write commands (`+reply`, `+forward`, `+send`) are ONLY allowed during `/act` mode and ONLY after explicit user approval for each action. Pulse triage itself (the default) remains 100% read-only.

protected_invariants.heading: Tool Boundaries
protected_invariants.text: - forbidden: delegation decisions, orchestration, runtime execution control

protected_invariants.heading: Required Inputs
protected_invariants.text: ## Required Inputs

protected_invariants.heading: Required Inputs
protected_invariants.text: - `gws` CLI authenticated (`gws auth status` must pass)

protected_invariants.heading: Required Output
protected_invariants.text: ## Required Output

protected_invariants.heading: Required Output
protected_invariants.text: Every pulse run must include:

protected_invariants.heading: Invocation
protected_invariants.text: | `engos-triage-my-inbox-chat-pulse /email` | Email only | 20 unread emails |

protected_invariants.heading: Invocation
protected_invariants.text: | `engos-triage-my-inbox-chat-pulse /chat` | Chat only | Unread msgs across configured spaces |

protected_invariants.heading: Invocation
protected_invariants.text: | `engos-triage-my-inbox-chat-pulse /hot` | High-priority only | 🔴+🟡 only, max 5 items, recency-filtered (12h 🔴 / 24h 🟡), executive summary first |

protected_invariants.heading: Invocation
protected_invariants.text: | `engos-triage-my-inbox-chat-pulse /count` | Counts only, no table | Fastest check: just priority counts per source |

protected_invariants.heading: Invocation
protected_invariants.text: | `engos-triage-my-inbox-chat-pulse /act <N>` | Act on specific item | Propose action for item #N only |

protected_invariants.heading: Invocation
protected_invariants.text: Help is terminal. Action and guided-workflow commands (`/thread`, `/open`, `/delete`, `/archive`, `/act`, `/rate`, `/memory`, `/tune`, `/config`, `/mute`, `/muted`, `/unmute`, and `/sweep`) do not compose with one another. They may accept only the source filters or arguments their own sections explicitly document. If an invocation contains more than one action or guided-workflow command, stop and ask the user to choose one.

protected_invariants.heading: Help Output
protected_invariants.text: 📡 Pulse — Comms Triage (triage is read-only; actions require approval)

protected_invariants.heading: Help Output
protected_invariants.text: engos-triage-my-inbox-chat-pulse /email                   Email only

protected_invariants.heading: Help Output
protected_invariants.text: engos-triage-my-inbox-chat-pulse /chat                    Chat only

protected_invariants.heading: Help Output
protected_invariants.text: engos-triage-my-inbox-chat-pulse /count                   Priority counts only (fastest)

protected_invariants.heading: Help Output
protected_invariants.text: engos-triage-my-inbox-chat-pulse /act <N>                 Propose action for item #N only

protected_invariants.heading: Help Output
protected_invariants.text: 🔴 Urgent         VIP senders, "action required", sole recipient, @mention + urgent

protected_invariants.heading: Help Output
protected_invariants.text: 🔵 FYI            Everything else (count only unless ≤5)

protected_invariants.heading: Configuration
protected_invariants.text: **`engos-triage-my-inbox-chat-pulse /config` reads and writes this file.** The skill itself never changes.

protected_invariants.heading: Sender Name Resolution
protected_invariants.text: **When a sender ID is not in the cache:** fall back to the space name as attribution (e.g., "someone in EGAI") — never display "unknown" and never guess or fabricate a name.

protected_invariants.heading: Step 3: Classify Priority
protected_invariants.text: |          |       | • Contains: "urgent", "ASAP", "blocking", "blocked", "action required", "EOD", "critical" |

protected_invariants.heading: Step 3: Classify Priority
protected_invariants.text: |          |       | • **Always 🔵 regardless of other rules. Never promoted above 🔵. Excluded from `/hot`.** |

protected_invariants.heading: Step 3: Classify Priority
protected_invariants.text: - No @mention → classify by content only

protected_invariants.heading: Step 3: Classify Priority
protected_invariants.text: **Executive relevance filter (applies to `/hot` only):** After classification and before presentation, apply a final filter that asks: "Does this require action or a decision from ME specifically, or is it team activity I'm being informed about?"

protected_invariants.heading: Step 3: Classify Priority
protected_invariants.text: **Self-message hiding:** Never show items where the sender is you (matching your email or chat user ID), UNLESS:

protected_invariants.heading: Step 4: Present Results
protected_invariants.text: - **Executive summary first:** Before the table, output 3-5 bullet points summarizing the key actionable items. Format: `[🔴|🟡] [person/topic]: [what needs your attention] — [recommended action]`. No age in bullets — age lives in the table only. This is the primary output — the table is the detail view.

protected_invariants.heading: Step 4: Present Results
protected_invariants.text: - **Max-age filter:** Only show 🔴 items ≤ 12h old and 🟡 items ≤ 24h old. Older items drop to a stale footer: `⏰ N stale items (>12h/24h) — run full pulse to see`

protected_invariants.heading: Step 4: Present Results
protected_invariants.text: - **No plumbing lines.** Omit all meta/stats lines: no "N emails auto-filtered", no "N chat-notification emails suppressed", no memory/signal counts, no source summary footer, no mute count footer. The only footer lines allowed are: stale count, overflow count, and Jira awareness line (if Jira tickets were downgraded).

protected_invariants.heading: Step 4: Present Results
protected_invariants.text: - **No separate action list.** The Action column in the table is sufficient for /hot. Do not append the detailed proposed action list — it's redundant at this item count.

protected_invariants.heading: Step 4: Present Results
protected_invariants.text: - If `/count`, show counts only (no table)

protected_invariants.heading: Step 4c: Quick Delete / Archive (when `/delete` or `/archive` is active)
protected_invariants.text: Act on email items by number from the most recent table after explicit approval. No sweep workflow is needed.

protected_invariants.heading: Step 4c: Quick Delete / Archive (when `/delete` or `/archive` is active)
protected_invariants.text: - Only works on email items (chat messages can't be deleted/archived via API)

protected_invariants.heading: Step 4c: Quick Delete / Archive (when `/delete` or `/archive` is active)
protected_invariants.text: - Single or multiple items: list exactly what will be affected and wait for explicit approval before calling a write command

protected_invariants.heading: Memory System (`/rate` Learning)
protected_invariants.text: | `not_mentioned` | Conditional: only match when you're NOT @mentioned |

protected_invariants.heading: Memory System (`/rate` Learning)
protected_invariants.text: | `no_direct_question` | Conditional: only match when no question is directed at you |

protected_invariants.heading: Step 7: Action Step-Through (when `/act` is active)
protected_invariants.text: **Safety:** NEVER auto-send. Every response requires explicit approval. NEVER fabricate information.

protected_invariants.heading: Step 8: Tune Session (when `/tune` is active)
protected_invariants.text: - `engos-triage-my-inbox-chat-pulse /tune /email` — only email messages

protected_invariants.heading: Step 8: Tune Session (when `/tune` is active)
protected_invariants.text: - `engos-triage-my-inbox-chat-pulse /tune /chat` — only chat messages

protected_invariants.heading: Step 9: Config (when `/config` is active)
protected_invariants.text: **Storage:** Config lives in `~/.kiro/scratch/pulse/config.json`, never in the generated skill. The agent reads the current JSON values, walks through each property, and writes only that config file after the user approves the proposed changes.

protected_invariants.heading: Step 9: Config (when `/config` is active)
protected_invariants.text: - Only update values the user wants to change

protected_invariants.heading: Step 10: Sweep (when `/sweep` is active)
protected_invariants.text: - **Stale threads:** messages older than 7 days that were never 🔴 or 🟡

protected_invariants.heading: Step 10: Sweep (when `/sweep` is active)
protected_invariants.text: - `only <criteria>` — filter the list by natural language (e.g., `only calendar`, `only datadog`, `only older than 1d`)

protected_invariants.heading: Step 10: Sweep (when `/sweep` is active)
protected_invariants.text: **In-session filtering with `only`:**

protected_invariants.heading: Step 10: Sweep (when `/sweep` is active)
protected_invariants.text: After the table is shown, `only` re-filters without re-fetching:

protected_invariants.heading: Step 10: Sweep (when `/sweep` is active)
protected_invariants.text: > only calendar

protected_invariants.heading: Step 10: Sweep (when `/sweep` is active)
protected_invariants.text: > only gitlab              # just GitLab items

protected_invariants.heading: Step 10: Sweep (when `/sweep` is active)
protected_invariants.text: > only older than 12h      # just items older than 12 hours

protected_invariants.heading: Step 10: Sweep (when `/sweep` is active)
protected_invariants.text: > only siteops datadog    # Site ops + Datadog items

protected_invariants.heading: Step 10: Sweep (when `/sweep` is active)
protected_invariants.text: > only delete              # just items proposed for delete

protected_invariants.heading: Step 10: Sweep (when `/sweep` is active)
protected_invariants.text: - NEVER auto-execute. Every batch requires explicit approval.

protected_invariants.heading: Step 10: Sweep (when `/sweep` is active)
protected_invariants.text: - All-delete batch: `Type "delete" to confirm, or n to cancel` (extra friction for destructive-only operations)

protected_invariants.heading: Step 10: Sweep (when `/sweep` is active)
protected_invariants.text: - Default to archive, not delete. Only propose delete for vendor marketing, exact duplicates, or obvious spam.

protected_invariants.heading: Step 10: Sweep (when `/sweep` is active)
protected_invariants.text: - NEVER propose archiving/deleting messages from VIPs or direct reports.

protected_invariants.heading: Step 10: Sweep (when `/sweep` is active)
protected_invariants.text: - NEVER propose archiving/deleting messages classified as 🔴 or 🟡.

protected_invariants.heading: What Pulse Does NOT Do
protected_invariants.text: - Triage mode (default) is 100% read-only — it never sends, modifies, or deletes anything.

protected_invariants.heading: What Pulse Does NOT Do
protected_invariants.text: - `/act` mode can send replies/messages, but ONLY with explicit per-item user approval.

protected_invariants.heading: What Pulse Does NOT Do
protected_invariants.text: - It never auto-sends, auto-archives, or auto-deletes. Ever.

protected_invariants.heading: Taking Action After Pulse
protected_invariants.text: After reviewing pulse output, the user may want to act. Pulse surfaces the ID and suggests the command but **never auto-executes**:

protected_invariants.heading: Taking Action After Pulse
protected_invariants.text: Always present the command with the real ID from the table. Always wait for explicit approval.
